what_this_file_is: All generated differentiating tests grouped by what happened when they were run against the real gold patch.

passed_gold.meaning: The real gold patch passed these tests. They were accepted into the bank as tests that later candidate patches must pass.

tests.test_name: Custom BoundField data is used throughout form processing

failed_gold.meaning: The real gold patch failed these tests. The accepted/rejected split shows whether that failure became an active must-fail constraint.

accepted.meaning: The gold failure was retained as a meaningful must-fail constraint for later candidates.

rejected.meaning: The gold patch failed, but the test was rejected and was not used as a later requirement.

rejected_before_reusable_test_creation.meaning: These attempts were rejected because the expected target-test failure could not be identified, so no reusable test-bank entry was created.
